en: Black‑and‑white view along a calm river or canal toward a medieval brick city gate with two tall conical spires and crenellated round towers. The gate straddles the water with an arched passage for boats beneath it. On the left bank stands a simple white riverside house and farm buildings; on the right, trees and a quay line the water. The overall look is of an old European town gate reflected in the water, printed in postcard-like format without a visible border or caption.
